name: jalco-drop
description: A self-hosted file transfer interface for people and agents. Runs on Cloudflare or Docker.

scripts.build: esbuild client/grain.js --bundle --minify --format=esm --outfile=public/grain.js && esbuild client/forms.js --minify --outfile=public/js/forms.js && esbuild client/islands.tsx --bundle --minify --format=esm --splitting --outdir=public/js --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' --jsx=automatic && tailwindcss -i src/styles.css -o public/style.css --minify && cp bin/jalco-drop public/cli
scripts.dev: wrangler dev -c $(test -f wrangler.local.jsonc && echo wrangler.local.jsonc || echo wrangler.jsonc) --host localhost:8787
scripts.deploy: wrangler deploy -c $(test -f wrangler.local.jsonc && echo wrangler.local.jsonc || echo wrangler.jsonc)
scripts.build:node: npm run build && esbuild src/node.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/server.mjs --jsx=automatic --external:puppeteer-core --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.test:node: npm run build:node && SMOKE_TARGET=node bash test/smoke.sh
scripts.test:e2e:node: npm run build && npm run build:node && E2E_TARGET=node playwright test
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:node && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:e2e:node
scripts.build:neon: npm run build && esbuild src/neon-entry.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --jsx=automatic --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/neon/index.mjs && rm -rf dist/neon/public && cp -R public dist/neon/public
scripts.deploy:neon: npm run build:neon && npx neon@latest deploy --env .env
scripts.test:neon: npm run build:neon && SMOKE_TARGET=neon STORAGE=s3 S3_ENDPOINT=$AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_S3 S3_BUCKET=${DROPS_BUCKET:-drops} bash test/smoke.sh
scripts.build:neon-package: npm run build && node scripts/embed-assets.mjs src/neon-assets.json && esbuild src/neon-package.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --jsx=automatic --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --alias:jalco-drop-assets=./src/neon-assets.json --outfile=neon/index.mjs

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: The master key for `/admin` and the API. Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 32` and keep it in a password manager.

DROPS.description: Where uploads, tokens and settings are stored.
